# unscii 2.1

`unscii-16.hex` is the 8 by 16 variant of unscii 2.1 by Viznut, in the hex format of GNU Unifont,
downloaded unchanged from <http://viznut.fi/unscii/unscii-16.hex>. The source of the release is
<http://viznut.fi/unscii/unscii-2.1-src.tar.gz>. unscii-16 is in the public domain. The variant
`unscii-16-full` is under the GPL and is not used.

The SHA-256 of the file is `2642c8b748fa81f24d76772d70c55faa720d98fadfec8133daf89136c5c8bfb1`.

`cmake/unscii.cmake` converts the glyphs of the 256 characters of code page 437 to a C++ header at
build time for the setup wizard of the SDL game.
